svg.title: Apache Druid service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Apache Druid: seven coarse-grained separately deployable service roles registered as CLI commands in Main.java — Router, Broker, Coordinator, Overlord, Historical, MiddleManager, Indexer — organized across query, ingestion, data, and coordination tiers.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do external clients send queries and ingestion requests to Druid?')
sendPrompt('What does the Druid Router service do — CliRouter?')
g.text: CliRouter — routes queries to Broker, ingest to Overlord

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Druid Broker service do — CliBroker?')
g.text: CliBroker — external queries, scatter-gather across Historicals

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Druid Overlord service do — CliOverlord?')
sendPrompt('What does the Druid Historical service do — CliHistorical?')
g.text: CliHistorical — stores and serves immutable segments

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What do MiddleManager and Indexer do in Druid — CliMiddleManager and CliIndexer?')
g.text: CliMiddleManager / CliIndexer — Peon tasks, push segments

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is deep storage in Apache Druid?')
g.text: S3 / HDFS / GCS — shared immutable segment store

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Druid Coordinator service do — CliCoordinator?')
g.text: CliCoordinator — manages data availability, segment assignment and load balancing across Historicals

svg.text: All roles registered as CLI server commands in services/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/cli/Main.java
